stories.title: U.S. imposes 50% tariffs on Canadian goods as trade talks collapse
new_facts: Carney rejected the failed deal as 'unfair'
First report: US imposes 50% tariff on $20bn Canadian imports; Canada vows dollar-for-dollar retaliation.
Carney's full quote: US last-minute changes were 'unfair, uneconomic' and undermined deal reliability
Names Mark Carney as PM who suspended talks after days of negotiations ended in impasse.
Reveals Trump extended the original tariff deadline by three days before it took effect.
Adds US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, who called it a 'missed opportunity for Canada.'
stories.line: U.S. imposes 50% tariffs on $20 billion in Canadian goods after trade talks fail; Canada pledges matching tariffs.
